metadata.description: Update the rules for a specific pipeline within a given object type in HubSpot.
metadata.learn_more: Update the rules for a specific pipeline within a given object type in HubSpot. This operation allows you to modify governance validation rules and approval stages for the specified pipeline. It is useful for maintaining or altering the workflow rules associated with your pipelines.

objectTypeId.label: Object Type Id
objectTypeId.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the pipeline rules are being updated.

pipelineId.label: Pipeline Id
pipelineId.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose rules are being updated.

approvalStage.label: Approval Stage
approvalStage.description: A rule that defines the approval process for a specific pipeline stage. It is defined using the PublicApprovalStageRuleRequest schema.

noBackwardsMovementRule.label: No Backwards Movement Rule
noBackwardsMovementRule.description: A rule that prevents moving backwards in the pipeline stages. It is defined using the PublicSequenceValidationRule schema.

noSkippingStagesRule.label: No Skipping Stages Rule
noSkippingStagesRule.description: A rule that prevents skipping stages in the pipeline. It is defined using the PublicSequenceValidationRule schema.

objectCreationRule.label: Object Creation Rule
objectCreationRule.description: A rule that specifies conditions for object creation within the pipeline. It is defined using the PublicObjectCreationRule schema.
